info.title: Gizra Vendor API
info.description: Vendor web panel and POS endpoints

tags.name: Vendor Restaurant Setup
tags.description: Restaurant Web Panel **Config** (business setup): GET/PUT /vendor/restaurant/business-setup, open/close PUT /vendor/restaurant/active-status, toggles PUT /vendor/restaurant/setting-toggle, SEO PUT /vendor/restaurant/meta-data, hours POST/DELETE /vendor/restaurant/schedules. Bearer from POST /vendor/login.

tags.name: Vendor Orders (Web Panel & POS)
tags.description: Marketplace orders from consumer app (POST /consumer/order/place). Shared by Restaurant Web Panel and Vendor POS/kitchen app — same Bearer JWT from POST /vendor/login. Web Panel: SSE GET /vendor/orders/events for instant new-order alerts (no polling). Does not include in-store POS sales (order_type=pos). POS also receives FCM push type=new_order when configured. **Manual dispatch:** POST /vendor/dispatch/request-driver (phone order → zone drivers via FCM + Socket `order_request`).

tags.name: Vendor Notifications
tags.description: GET /vendor/notifications, DELETE /notifications/{id}. New-order and admin broadcasts.

bearerAuth.description: **Customer JWT** — from POST `/consumer/login` or `/consumer/sign-in-with-google` (`data.token`). **Guest JWT** — from POST `/consumer/guest/request` (`data.token`, claim `role: guest`); valid for cart (and guest checkout flows), not for profile/favourites/addresses.

PlaceOrderRequest.description: Checkout payload. Use saved address via delivery_address_id, or inline address fields when no id. For delivery, distance (km) is required. Cart checkout: omit items/cart and use DB cart; buy-now: set is_buy_now true with items (or cart array). Guest checkout: send guest_id from POST /consumer/guest/request when not using Bearer token.

price.description: Optional for buy-now; server uses menu price when loading from cart DB

address.description: Required for delivery if delivery_address_id omitted

cart_id.description: Order only this cart row when not buy-now

guest_id.description: Required for guest checkout when no Bearer token

post.description:
Creates a **manual dispatch** delivery order (`is_manual_dispatch=true`, `order_status=confirmed`) for phone/walk-in orders from the **Vendor POS** app. Requires **`manual_dispatch`** enabled on the restaurant (Business Setup toggle) or restaurant id listed in admin `manual_dispatch_restaurants`.

**Idempotency:** repeat calls with the same `idempotency_key` return the existing order summary (no duplicate jobs).

**Side effects (drivers):**
1. **FCM** — `order_request` push to all vehicle topics in the restaurant zone + zone-wide topic.
2. **Socket.IO** — event **`order_request`** on the same FCM topic rooms (drivers connected with delivery-man JWT). Request-tab clients should refetch `GET /delivery-man/orders/latest` on this event.
3. **`user_notifications`** — inbox row for each approved driver in the zone.

Mirrors legacy PHP `POST /vendor/dispatch/request-driver`.
